title: A polynomial time algebraic solution to exact marginal inference in Markov Random Field models
abstract: arXiv:1709.09051v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper develops on algebraic grounds a polynomial time exact linear solution to the hard combinatorial problem of marginal inference in Markov random field (MRF) models under general assumptions. To prove our claim, we first implicitly remodel a MRF joint distribution as the unique solution of some linear identity assuming its clique potential functions (equivalently, its individual conditional distributions) to be specified. Then, by assuming an arbitrary point subset, we relax accordingly such a (global) linear identity for deriving a second linear identity, solely, acting on a polynomial time number of entries (e.g.; local marginals or Fourier frequencies) of a solution. Then, we show, only using linear algebraic techniques, that such an identity enables to capture all the entries necessary for the exact reconstruction of an MRF marginal distribution, thus, allowing to solve for the latter, exactly and in polynomial time

translated_title: 马尔可夫随机场模型中精确边际推断问题的多项式时间代数解法
translated_abstract: 本文在代数基础上，针对马尔可夫随机场（MRF）模型中边际推断这一困难组合问题，在一般假设条件下提出了一种多项式时间的精确线性解法。为证明这一论断，我们首先在团势函数（等价地，即其个体条件分布）已给定的情况下，将MRF联合分布隐式地重塑为某个线性恒等式的唯一解。然后，通过假设一个任意的点子集，我们相应地对该（全局）线性恒等式进行松弛，推导出第二个线性恒等式，该恒等式仅作用于解中多项式数量的条目（例如局部边际或傅里叶频率）。随后，我们仅使用线性代数技术证明，这样的恒等式能够捕获精确重构MRF边际分布所需的全部条目，从而可以精确且在多项式时间内求解后者。
tldr: 本文通过将MRF联合分布重塑为线性恒等式的唯一解，并将其松弛为仅涉及多项式数量条目的线性恒等式，利用线性代数技术首次实现了马尔可夫随机场模型边际推断问题的多项式时间精确求解。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a polynomial-time algebraic linear solution for exact marginal inference in Markov Random Field models by remodeling the joint distribution as the unique solution of a linear identity, then relaxing it to an identity on a polynomial number of entries that captures all information needed for exact reconstruction.
